invert_colors.docs:
**boolean**: Display hardware color invesion. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [ST7567 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7567#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The RESET pin. Defaults to not connected.

*See also: [ST7567 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7567#configuration-variables)*

mirror_x.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the physical X axis.

*See also: [ST7567 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7567#configuration-variables)*

mirror_y.docs:
**boolean**: If true, mirror the physical Y axis.

*See also: [ST7567 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7567#configuration-variables)*

transform.docs:
Transform the display presentation using hardware. All defaults are `false`.

*See also: [ST7567 LCD Graphic Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/st7567#configuration-variables)*
